<!-- Release: v0.20.3 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Consolidate artwork filtering, list moves, preference decoding and shared controls while preserving v0.20.2 behavior; remove unused player and preview code.
- Add an Apple-sourced Liquid Glass field guide with original motion studies, and simplify the project documentation.

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/108 - Source and documentation consolidation without a UI redesign.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/109 - Apple evidence, proposed material/motion rules and illustrated guide.

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.20.3-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted. It updates the existing development app.
3. First use: open **More → Scan music**, choose **Folders to scan**, then **Scan now**.
